title: Singapore PM says no chip-control evasion route amid Megaspeed probe
summary: Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said Singapore will not be used as a conduit for companies to evade U.S. chip export controls, as authorities investigate Megaspeed&\#x27;s purchases of Nvidia chips. The statement followed the U.S. Commerce Department&\#x27;s addition of Megaspeed and six other Southeast Asian companies to a trade blacklist; the Federal Register cited a “significant risk” that they would divert advanced computing products to unauthorized users and said the designations include related entities in Malaysia and Thailand. Reuters reported that Alibaba&\#x27;s Singapore subsidiary Apex Enterprise Solutions was also listed, and Alibaba said it had never transferred controlled advanced computing chips.
